title: PatchSetUndoResponse
description: Response body of POST /api/patch-sets/:id/undo (HEL-413). One EditUndoOutcome per journaled edit, in ascending index order. Restores every edit in the named application to its pre-apply state, or restores none of them (a conflict, or a delete edit whose kind has no restoring create API, refuses the whole call with a 409 before this shape is ever returned -- see design.md D4/D4a).

EditUndoOutcome.description: status: restored (an update edit's captured pre-apply state was reapplied, or a create edit's created resource was deleted) | recreated (a delete edit's resource was recreated under a NEW id -- panel/pipelineStep only) | failed (a genuine, unforeseeable restore failure for THIS edit) | notAttempted (never reached because an earlier edit in the same reverse walk failed -- design.md D4's narrower third guarantee tier).

index.description: The journaled edit's position in the original patch set's edits array.

newId.description: The new id replacing the deleted one, for a 'recreated' delete-undo. For a 'restored' create-undo, the just-deleted resource's own id (the only field on the wire that can identify which resource was removed, since resultingState/priorState are both absent once it no longer exists). Absent otherwise.

resultingState.description: The resource's full post-restore state for a 'restored' update or a 'recreated' delete-undo, serialized using its target kind's existing response shape. Absent for a 'restored' create-undo (the resource was deleted), a 'failed', or a 'notAttempted' edit.

inlineSources.description: HEL-1493: for a 'restored' pipeline create-undo whose journal recorded the inline root sources the apply created, one entry per source saying whether undo removed it. Absent for every other edit, for a journal entry written before inline sources were recorded (the source survives), and for a create that made no inline source.

InlineSourceUndoOutcome.description: What undoing a pipeline create did to one inline root source the apply created. removed: deleted (with its implicit Connector, if any). kept: still referenced by something, or it could not be removed; reason says which. alreadyGone: it no longer existed.

name.description: The source's name, when it could be read.

reason.description: Present exactly when result is 'kept': for a still-referenced source UI-safe text naming the referencing resources the caller can see (hidden ones as a count only, no ids), otherwise a fixed sentence.
